name: Christine Daaé
original_name: クリスティーヌ・ダーエ
source: Christine's a quiet woman with a strong heart. Because her every day efforts and practice to become the "prima donna" of the company aren't enough, she has developed an inferiority complex.
translation: Christine's a quiet woman with a strong heart. Because her every day efforts and practice to become the "prima donna" of the company aren't enough, she has developed an inferiority complex.
